• The AUGUR 5 system is a very effective tool for the ultrasonic testing of the austenitic weld Du300.

the development of new ultrasonic testing methods for the detection of flaws in austenitic weld joints and their sizing with the aim to improve the reliability of the nuclear power plant equipment.
development of UT procedures and equipment for inspection of austenitic welded joints of NPP equipment.
the development of the ultrasonic inspection of austenitic materials and welds at the Russian NPT.
